Description: Lash Her stateless API host and attached static IPv4 - separate environment stacks with administrator-controlled provisioning.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: One host per environment; external PostgreSQL; gateway, API and worker containers are installed by the separate application release workflow.
must: Provision only through administrator-controlled access; do not widen LashHerDeploymentRole.
Use separate stacks and hosts for staging and production.
No authoritative application data, credentials or database backups belong in this template or on the root disk.
Check the account and region against provisioning.json before creating a change set.

ref.has: Provisioning inputs, lifecycle, validation and release boundaries

Environment.Description: One environment per stack. Never place staging workloads on the production host.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Verified available in the deployment region; recheck before provisioning.

BundleId.Description: 4 GB capacity-test candidate; 8 GB requires a deliberate size/cost choice. Neither is certified capacity.

OperatorIpv4Cidr.ConstraintDescription: Supply the approved operator's single public IPv4 address with /32.
OperatorIpv4Cidr.Description: Required SSH source; no broad network, browser-SSH alias or IPv6 SSH access.

KeyPairName.Description: Existing region-specific Lightsail key pair. Supply its name, never its private key.

HostOperator.Description: Assigned operations owner identifier for patching, certificates and host recovery; no personal contact details.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stateless compute is reproducible; 4 GB starts capacity testing. Explicit ports replace default public SSH. Ubuntu LTS prepares the host without deploying applications.
must: Keep Project and Environment tags aligned with the scoped deployment role.
Only IPv4 gateway HTTPS and operator /32 SSH are publicly permitted; IPv6 ingress is closed.
Do not publish API, database, worker, metrics or internal TLS ports.
P1-04 must enforce Docker forwarding rules; UFW alone does not restrict Docker port publishing.
Deletion destroys the root disk. Keep recoverable release configuration and secrets off-host.

Fn::Join: apt-get install -y ufw unattended-upgrades ca-certificates curl

Fn::Join.Fn::Sub: ufw allow from ${OperatorIpv4Cidr} to any port 22 proto tcp

Fn::Join: ufw allow from 0.0.0.0/0 to any port 443 proto tcp
printf '%s\n' 'Host preparation complete; application release and Docker forwarding controls are still required.' > /opt/lash-her/host-prepared

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A stable public IPv4 supports gateway DNS across host stop/start and planned replacement. Delete with temporary staging to avoid unattached-address charges.
must: Attach only to this environment's host; no shared staging/production address.
Record DNS separately after verifying the allocated address; this template does not alter DNS.

InstanceName.Description: Environment-specific host name for scoped deployment operations.

GatewayIpv4.Description: Allocated IPv4; verify before assigning gateway DNS.

ApplicationEnvironment.Description: Business environment assigned to this host.
